verses.text: Ay jun winh skuch Acán t'a yinhtilal Judá, yuninal winhaj Carmi, yixchikin winhaj Zabdi, yinhtilal winhaj Zera, ix yik'b'at juntzanh tas winh ay yowalil yik'jib'ati. Masanil heb' israel ix och lokan yuj smul winh chi', yuj chi' ix kot yowal sk'o'ol Jehová t'a yib'anh heb'.

Ayik ayek' winhaj Josué yet' heb' israel t'a Jericó, ix schekanb'at jaywanh heb' winh winak winh yik sb'at yilan heb' winh chajtil yaj chonhab' Hai. Haton jun ay t'a yichanhkot Betel t'a slak'anil Bet-awén. Ix b'at heb' winh yila' tas yaj jun chonhab' chi'.

Haxo ix jax heb' winh, ix yalan heb' winh t'a winhaj Josué chi' icha tik: Manh yowalilok sb'at heb' winh chonhab' tik smasanil, palta anhej chab'ok, ma oxe'ok mil heb' winh sb'at yak' owal yet' heb', yik manh tonhejok syixtej sb'a heb' winh smasanil, yujto kennhej heb' stanhwan jun chonhab' chi', xchi heb' winh.
Yuj chi' anhejam oxe'ok mil heb' winh soldado ix b'at yak' owal yet' heb' aj Hai chi'. Palta haxo ix aji, ix ak'ji ganar heb' winh soldado israel chi' yuj heb'.

Ix pechji heb' winh t'a spuerta'il chonhab' chi' masanto t'a juntzanh lugar b'aj tz'ik'ji'elta k'e'en k'e'en stzeyji. Ix miljicham 36 heb' winh soldado israel chi' yuj heb' t'a sat witz t'a yalanh jun chonhab' chi', yuj chi' ix te xiw heb' israel chi' smasanil, ix chab'axk'e sk'o'ol heb'.

Yuj chi', ha winhaj Josué yet' heb' winh yajalil chonhab', ix snhik'b'at spichul heb' winh yuj kusk'olal, ix yak'anpaxk'e pokok heb' winh t'a sjolom, ix lajwi chi', ix em kumnaj heb' winh t'a yichanh te' skaxa'il strato Jehová, ix emk'och snanhal sat heb' winh t'a sat lu'um masanto ix em k'u.

Ix yalan winhaj Josué chi' icha tik: --Ay Mamin Jehová, ¿tas yuj ix ik'ek'ta ha chonhab' tik t'a sk'axepal ha' Jordán tik? ¿Tom yuj honh satanel heb' amorreo, yuj chi' honh ik'ek'ta t'a jun lugar tik? Te wach' hama, ta ix honh kan t'a sk'axepalek' ha' Jordán chi'.
Ay Mamin, ¿tasto wal ol wala'? Ha heb' ha chonhab' tik toxonhej ix el heb' t'a heb' ajk'o'ol.

Haxo heb' cananeo yet' masanil chonhab' kajan t'a juntzanh lugar tik, ol yab' spekal heb' tas ix sk'ulej heb' ha chonhab' tik, ol smolb'an sb'a heb', haxo honh satanel heb' chi', manhxo ol honh b'inaj t'a sat lum tik. Haxo heb' anima, chuk ol yal heb' t'a ha patik, xchi winh.
Ix tak'wi Jehová t'a winh icha tik: --K'e'anh wa'an, ¿tas tza k'ulej?

Ha heb' heyetisraelal tik ix och smul, yujto maj sk'anab'ajej heb' tas ix wal t'ayex. Ix yelk'ejkot tastak heb' ix wala' to satel smasanil. Ix elk'an heb', ix yik'ankot heb' t'a elk'altak, ix sk'ub'anel heb' b'aj kajan.

Yuj wal chi' maxtzak yal-laj he tek'b'an he b'a t'a heb' heyajk'o'ol chi', tzex el t'a heb'. Yuj chi' ha tikne'ik smoj wal tzex sateli. Tato manh ol he satel masanil tas ix wala' to tze sateli, wal yel manhxo ol hin och heyet'ok.

Ha tikne'ik jun, k'e'anh wa'an, al t'a heb' anima tik to sakb'itej sb'a heb', syak'an lista sb'a heb', yujto ha k'ik'an sjawi heb' t'a wichanh smasanil. Ha hin Jehová he Diosal hin swala': T'a he kal ha hex israel hex tik, ay tas ix wala' to satji'eli, yuj chi' tato hanheja' he k'ub'aneli, wal yel manhxo ol yal he tek'b'an he b'a t'a heb' heyajk'o'ol chi'.

Ha k'ik'an, t'a junjun inhtilal tz'aj he ja t'a wichanh. Ha jun inhtilal tzin ch'oxo', ha t'a skal jun chi' ay jun inhtilal tz'och t'a wichanh t'a junjun makan. Ha jun makan tzin ch'ox chi', sjawi t'a wichanh t'a junjun familia'il, haxo jun familia tzin ch'ox chi', sjawi masanil heb' winh winak ay t'a skal, t'a junjunal sja heb' winh t'a wichanh.

Ha t'a winh tz'ilchajelta tas ix wala' to satji'eli, ha jun winh chi' snhusjitz'a winh yet' yetb'eyum, yuninal yet' masanil tastak ay t'ay, yujto ix sk'ulej winh tas manh smojok, maj sk'anab'ajej hin trato winh, xchi Jehová.
Haxo t'a junxo k'u, ix pet k'e wa'an winhaj Josué chi', ix yalan winh to smolb'ej sb'a heb' anima t'a junjun inhtilal. Elanhchamel ix ch'oxji yinhtilal winhaj Judá yuj Jehová.

Ix yalan winhaj Josué chi' to makkiltak tz'aj sch'oxan sb'a heb' yinhtilal Judá chi'. Haxo t'a skal heb', hata' ix sch'ox heb' yinhtilal winhaj Zera Jehová, haxo pax t'a skal heb' chi' ix elta heb' yinhtilal winhaj Zabdi.

Junjunal ix aj snitzankot sb'a heb' yinhtilal winhaj Zabdi chi'. Haxo t'a skal heb' ix ch'oxji winhaj Acán yuninal winhaj Carmi, yixchikin winhaj Zabdi schab'il yixchikin winhaj Zera, t'a yinhtilal Judá yuj Jehová.

Ixlajwi chi' ix yalan winhaj Josué t'a winhaj Acán chi' icha tik: --Ach wetchonhab', t'a yichanh Jehová ko Diosal ha honh israel honh tik, jichan wal tzala' tas chukal ix ha k'ulej, manh ha k'ub'ejeli, xchi winh.
Ix tak'wi winhaj Acán chi' icha tik: --Wal yel ix och hin mul t'a Jehová ko Diosal. Ay ton juntzanh tas ix welk'ejkoti.

Ha t'a skal masanil tastak ay t'a Jericó, ix wik'kot jun k'apak k'apak kotnak t'a Babilonia, yujto te wach' yilji k'apak yet' k'e'en plata oye' am libra yalil yet' jun telanh k'e'en oro ay am junok libra yalil. Ix wiloch hin k'o'ol t'a juntzanh chi', yuj chi' ix wik'koti. Ha t'a snanhal yol hin mantiado mukan wu'uj. Ha k'e'en plata chi' ha t'a yalanh aykanem k'e'en, xchi winh.

Ixlajwi chi', ix schekanb'at juntzanh heb' winh winak winhaj Josué chi' yil t'a yol smantiado winhaj Acán chi'. Elanhchamel ix b'at heb' winh, ix b'at sjoyank'eta juntzanh chi' heb' winh. Ha t'a yalanh, hata' ayem k'e'en oro yet' k'e'en plata chi'.
Ix yik'ankot heb' winh t'a winhaj Josué chi' t'a yichanh masanil heb' israel. Ixlajwi chi' ix ak'ji'och t'a yichanh Jehová.

Haxo winhaj Josué chi' yet' masanil heb' israel chi' ix yaman winhaj Acán chi' yet' juntzanh chi': Haton k'e'en plata, jun k'apak k'apak, jun telanh k'e'en oro, heb' yuninal winh, heb' ix yisil winh, nok' wakax, nok' b'uru, nok' kalnel, smantiado winh yet' masanil tas ay t'a heb'. Ix yik'anb'at heb' israel chi' t'a jun ak'lik skuchan Acor.

Haxo yik ix k'och heb' ta' ix yalan winhaj Josué chi' icha tik: --¿Tas yuj ix ik'kot jun yahelal chi' t'a kib'anh? Ha tikne'ik jun, yak'okab'kot yahelal Jehová t'a ib'anh, xchi winh. Ixlajwi yalan juntzanh chi' winh, ix syamanoch heb' israel chi' sjulk'enancham winhaj Acán chi' yet' masanil heb' yuninal. Ixlajwi chi' ix snhusankantz'a heb' masanil tastak ay t'a winh.

Ixlajwi chi', ix k'ekan juyanh k'e'en k'e'en t'a yib'anh heb', ix kannhej jun juyanh k'e'en k'e'en chi' ta', yuj chi' Acor ix sb'i'ejkan jun ak'lik chi'. Icha chi' ix aj yoch wa'an yowal sk'o'ol Jehová t'a yib'anh chonhab' Israel.
